arguments.where_clause: transactions.transaction_type = 'Swipe Transaction' AND transactions.merchant_location_id IN (SELECT ml.id FROM merchant_locations ml WHERE ml.city = 'Rome' AND ml.state = 'Italy')
arguments.explanation: Flags swipe transactions whose merchant location is in Rome, Italy.
assumptions: 'Rome' is matched as an exact, case-sensitive city name and 'Italy' as the exact state value, since merchant_locations.state holds the country name for locations outside the US.
Location is matched through merchant_location_id, not merchant_id.
No date range is applied, so the rule covers the full 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31 period.
